root_cause: The auto-integrator attempted to reconcile CAPITAL-GUARD-KERNEL-001 after PR #6078 merged into dev at 2026-10-01T15:20:45Z (merge commit 6377295aafe0b6250e5e2b00a6327b9b7d81e045). However, fetch_pr_for_task queried candidate.branch ('task/CAPITAL-GUARD-KERNEL-001') rather than the canonical delivery/review bound head branch ('task/CAPITAL-GUARD-KERNEL-001-v3'). Finding no PRs on the unversioned branch, it queried superseding versions v2..v20 with state='merged', discovering both historical merged PR #6059 (v2, landed in generation 8) and current merged PR #6078 (v3, landed in generation 13). Because multiple merged versioned PRs were returned, fetch_pr_for_task raised AmbiguousPullRequests, leading to the pr-lookup-failed unblock task.

resolution.action: Updated scripts/git/auto_integrator.py fetch_pr_for_task to query resolve_authoritative_head_branch(candidate) before falling back to candidate.branch and superseding versions. When a task specifies a bound head branch in delivery_binding or review_binding (such as task/CAPITAL-GUARD-KERNEL-001-v3), fetch_pr_for_task discovers the exact intended PR directly without triggering ambiguous multi-version lookups across previous lifecycle PRs.
resolution.owned_layer: auto_integrator PR discovery alignment with authoritative delivery head branch, and unblock evidence
resolution.unchanged_layer: Integrator merge gate, review proof verification, canonical delivery binding, and product runtime source
resolution.composes_with: Supervisor auto-integrator reconciling CAPITAL-GUARD-KERNEL-001 against PR #6078 without ambiguous PR lookup failure

validation.result: Clean git diff check without whitespace issues

remaining_observations: The pr-lookup-failed blocker is resolved. PR #6078 is merged into dev and no longer stranded. When this unblock fix lands, auto-integrator will reconcile CAPITAL-GUARD-KERNEL-001 to update its canonical integration receipt to generation 13.
